root_causes: V4R1 response preparation and public release shared one serial goroutine
the shared lane made the next preparation wait for the previous public release
the frozen 25 ms lead was shorter than two observed cold first-slot preparation durations

repair.pipeline: serial public commitment -> fixed bounded preparation pool -> serial public release
repair.deadline_miss_rule: fail closed without shifting release to wait for private preparation

mechanical_basis.bounded_worker_capacity_assumption: six fixed lanes; verified by deterministic and live functional gates before any protected campaign
